name: Track-to-track association in collective perception
description: Dataset for track-to-track association in a collective perception scenario with central road side unit (RSU). The dataset was created using the artery simulator (https://artery.v2x-research.eu/).

citation.name: Wolf, Laura M., et al. "Track-to-Track Association for Collective Perception based on Stochastic Optimization." arXiv preprint arXiv:2510.21278 (2025).
